segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The ground support plan for that stope had been signed off about four months earlier... We let day shift go in and start drilling as scheduled.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant defaults to the unrevised support plan despite above-baseline microseismic events and available inspection alternatives.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The model came back with a 2.3... Stope 9 was just the one that was fresh in my head... I authorized the afternoon blast clearance.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant treats a precise model rating as settled despite a known blind spot and relies on one vivid prior event instead of broader comparison.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I leaned toward the crew's read... The inspector's note got filed... because the Stope 9 comparison made the pattern seem like something we already understood.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant treats similarity to one prior crack pattern as validating and selectively transmits reassuring reports while sidelining dissent.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: That rock fall didn't worry me much... it read to me as consistent with... minor settling... Twenty years gives you a feel for these things... I authorized the blast.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant interprets a minor rock fall as consistent with stability and expresses high confidence despite sensor lag and unresolved warning signs.
